category: Combat, V.A.T.S., Action Points, and Damage Calculation Engine

unarmedAndMeleeMechanics.standardMeleeScaling: +5% additive base damage per point of Strength.
unarmedAndMeleeMechanics.unarmedMeleeScaling: +10% additive base damage per point of Strength (double standard melee rate). Applies to Power Fist, Deathclaw Gauntlet, Gauntlet, Meat Hook, Boxing Glove, Knuckles, and bare fists.
unarmedAndMeleeMechanics.perkIronFist: +10% (Rank 1), +15% (Rank 2), +20% (Rank 3) additive base damage to unarmed weapons.

actionPointMechanics.baseRecoveryRate: 6.0% of total Action Point pool per second when not sprinting, jumping, or in V.A.T.S.
actionPointMechanics.recoveryDelay: 1.0 second delay after stopping AP consumption before passive regeneration begins.
actionPointMechanics.agilityScaling: Each point of Agility adds +10 Maximum Action Points.
actionPointMechanics.armorModPowered: +5.0 AP/second flat regeneration per piece (Up to +25.0 AP/second across 5 armor pieces).
actionPointMechanics.cannedCoffeeBurst: +12.0 AP/second for 25 seconds per can. Consuming multiple cans stacks multiplicatively, allowing continuous firing in V.A.T.S. without dropping out.

vatsMechanics.maximumHitChanceCap: 95% (Hit chance in V.A.T.S. can never exceed 95%, regardless of Perception or weapon accuracy buffs).
vatsMechanics.minimumHitChanceFloor: 0% (Unless line-of-sight is established, minimum floor is 0%).
vatsMechanics.rangeFalloff: Accuracy scales down dramatically past the weapon's listed effective range stat. Concentrated Fire perk increases hit chance by 10% / 15% / 20% on consecutive shots per target limb.
vatsMechanics.criticalHitFormula: V.A.T.S. criticals guarantee a 100% hit (ignoring accuracy falloff) and bypass non-boss flat damage reductions. Critical meter fills based on Luck: at 33 Luck with Critical Savvy Rank 3 (55% fill cost), a critical hit can be executed on every alternate shot (1 normal shot -> 1 crit -> 1 normal shot -> 1 crit). With 3★ Lucky (+15% crit charge), the requirement drops to 23 Luck.

damageMitigationAndPenetration.antiArmorCalculation: Anti-Armor reduces target's Armor and Energy Resistance by 50%. Combined with Tank Killer (+36% armor penetration) or Stabilized (+45% in PA), effective target resistance drops by up to ~68%–72.5%.
damageMitigationAndPenetration.tankKillerMechanics: Tank Killer reduces target Armor and Energy Resistance by 12% (Rank 1), 24% (Rank 2), and 36% (Rank 3). Following Patch 22 (One Wasteland), Tank Killer explicitly applies to both Rifles (Commando, Rifleman) AND Pistols (Gunslinger, Guerrilla).
damageMitigationAndPenetration.bowBeforeMeMechanics: Bow Before Me reduces target armor by 12% (Rank 1), 24% (Rank 2), and 36% (Rank 3), and provides stagger chances for Bows and Crossbows.
damageMitigationAndPenetration.incisorMechanics: Incisor reduces target armor by 25% (Rank 1), 50% (Rank 2), and 75% (Rank 3) for both 1H/2H Melee weapons AND Unarmed weapons.
damageMitigationAndPenetration.damageAdditiveVsMultiplicative: Standard perks (Commando, Rifleman, Gunslinger, Guerrilla, Archer, Slugger, Gladiator, Iron Fist) apply additive bonuses to weapon base damage. Note: Heavy Gunner damage cards were reworked in Patch 62+ into Bullet Storm (ramping sustained damage), Tightly Wound (spin-up speed), and Bringing the Big Guns (stack doubling). Vulnerability effects (Follow Through, Taking One for the Team) apply multiplicative final damage increases.
